higher_coherence_clue: The completion differential plays two levels at once: its boundary concomitant supplies the Wronskian 2-cell, while its graph square supplies the strict chamber margin needed after the conservative mate. This is a concrete mechanism by which the terminal object of one coherence phase seeds positivity in the next.

conclusion: A previously conditional quadratic-margin proposal has a natural source candidate: the graph metric of the actual theta completion differential C=partial^2-1/4. It gives an exact strict first-derivative bound. This does not yet prove the full Birman-Schwinger chamber, but it supplies the first non-fitted coercive component and links the Wronskian boundary phase to the next positive phase.
